description: Community Rating System Explorer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by The Nature Conservancy; CRS Insurance Services Office (ISO); FEMA Flood Map Service Center. FEMA’s Community Rating System (CRS) is a voluntary program that encourages communities to earn a discount on flood insurance premiums for actions that contribute to their flood risk reduction. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
